title: Circulating vaccine-derived poliovirus type 2 - Indonesia
summary: Indonesia reported four cases of circulating vaccine-derived poliovirus type 2 (cVDPV2) from October 2022 to February 2023, with three cases occurring in Aceh province and one case in West Java province.
